info.name: Search for annotated images.

params.name: creatorId
params.description: Limit to annotations created by this user

params.name: imageName
params.description: Filter results by image name (case-insensitive)

params.name: limit
params.description: Result set size limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into result set.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the result set by.

params.name: sortdir
params.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending, -1 for descending.

items.docs: By default, this endpoint will return a list of recently annotated images.  This list can be further filtered by passing the creatorId and/or imageName parameters.  The creatorId parameter will limit results to annotations created by the given user.  The imageName parameter will only include images whose name (or a token in the name) begins with the given string.

info.name: Get an annotation by id.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the annotation.

params.name: left
params.description: The left column of the area to fetch.

params.name: right
params.description: The right column (exclusive) of the area to fetch.

params.name: top
params.description: The top row of the area to fetch.

params.name: bottom
params.description: The bottom row (exclusive) of the area to fetch.

params.name: low
params.description: The lowest z value of the area to fetch.

params.name: high
params.description: The highest z value (exclusive) of the area to fetch.

params.name: minimumSize
params.description: Only annotations larger than or equal to this size in pixels will be returned.  Size is determined by the length of the diagonal of the bounding box of an element.  This probably should be 1 at the maximum zoom, 2 at the next level down, 4 at the next, etc.

params.name: maxDetails
params.description: Limit the number of annotations returned based on complexity.  The complexity of an annotation is how many points are used to defined it.  This is applied in addition to the limit.  Using maxDetails helps ensure results will be able to be rendered.

params.name: minElements
params.description: If maxDetails is specified, always return at least this many elements, even if they are very detailed.

params.name: centroids
params.description: If true, only return the centroids of each element.  The results are returned as a packed binary array with a json wrapper.

params.name: bbox
params.description: If true, add _bbox records to each element.  These are computed when the annotation is stored and cannot be modified.  Cannot be used with the centroids option.

params.name: limit
params.description: Result set size limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into result set.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the result set by.

params.name: sortdir
params.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending, -1 for descending.

items.docs: Use "size" or "details" as possible sort keys.
